# ANALYSIS: STAGE-1_BASELINE_BACKTEST_2026-08-24

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** baseline_evaluation
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We ran a Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness to evaluate the baseline engine's performance on the OP-16 anchor days, generate equity curve, walk-forward OOS results, and validate real-fills on the top 3 J days.

## Mechanism

The grinder harness executed the baseline engine (no candidate modifications) over the full 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills. It produced an equity curve, performed walk-forward analysis (IS/OOS split), and extracted real-fills P&L on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and three J loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** full 16-month OPRA dataset, no selection bias; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward.
3. **Out-of-sample:** walk-forward OOS results generated (see `analysis/recommendations/stage1_baseline_oos.json`).
4. **Real-fills:** real-fills validation on top 3 J days completed (see `analysis/recommendations/stage1_baseline_realfills.json`).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day -$1,200 (gap down on 5/06), max drawdown -$2,273, blow-up scenario if market gaps >2% against position at open.
6. **Concentration:** top-5 days = 48% of P&L (baseline equity curve shows moderate concentration).

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators PASS, walk-forward OOS Sharpe >0.70, real-fills validation diff <±20% on anchor days.
